name: BZFlag
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The classic 3D tank battle game. Runs bzfs with capture the flag, free-for-all or rabbit chase, on a random world or a map of your own, with BZFlag's plugins ready to load.
startup: export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=./lib; s=; case "{{GAME_STYLE}}" in ctf) s=-c ;; offa) s=-offa ;; rabbit) s=-rabbit ;; esac; exec ./bzfs -d -p {{SERVER_PORT}} -conf bzfs.conf -mp {{MAX_PLAYERS}} $s ${WORLD:+-world "$WORLD"} ${ADMIN_PASSWORD:+-passwd "$ADMIN_PASSWORD"} ${PUBLIC_KEY:+-publictitle "$SERVER_NAME" -publickey "$PUBLIC_KEY" -publicaddr "${PUBLIC_ADDRESS:-$SERVER_IP}:$SERVER_PORT"}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# BZFlag. Installs bzfs, BZFlag's server, with its plugins from Debian 13's
# bzflag-server package (BZFlag doesn't publish Linux builds of its own),
# checked against Debian's signed package list, for this node's CPU.
# bzfs.conf, your maps and the ban list are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build/root"
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

# Debian 13's packages, checked against Debian's signed package list.
debian_index() { # <cpu>: Debian's list of packages for that CPU (amd64, arm64)
    local f="main/binary-$1/Packages.xz" sum
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/InRelease" https://deb.debian.org/debian/dists/trixie/InRelease ||
        fail "Debian's archive can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    gpgv --keyring /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg --output "$build/Release" "$build/InRelease" 2>/dev/null ||
        fail "Debian's package list isn't signed by Debian. Reinstall to try again."
    sum=$(awk -v f="$f" 'length($1) == 64 && $3 == f { print $1 }' "$build/Release")
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/Packages.xz" "https://deb.debian.org/debian/dists/trixie/$f" ||
        fail "Debian's archive can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    [ -n "$sum" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$build/Packages.xz" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] ||
        fail "Debian's package list didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    xz -d "$build/Packages.xz"
}
debian_version() { # <package>: its version in the list
    awk -v p="$1" '/^Package: / { n = $2 } n == p && /^Version: / { print $2; exit }' "$build/Packages"
}
debian_unpack() { # <package>...: downloads each, checks it, and unpacks it into $build/root
    local p file sum
    for p in "$@"; do
        read -r file sum < <(awk -v p="$p" '/^Package: / { n = $2 } n == p && /^Filename: / { f = $2 } n == p && /^SHA256: / { s = $2 }
            /^$/ { if (n == p && f != "") { print f, s; exit } n = "" }' "$build/Packages") || true
        [ -n "${file:-}" ] || fail "Debian has no package $p for this CPU."
        curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/$p.deb" "https://deb.debian.org/debian/$file" ||
            fail "The download of $p from Debian failed. Reinstall to try again."
        [ "$(sha256sum "$build/$p.deb" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || fail "$p from Debian didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
        dpkg-deb -x "$build/$p.deb" "$build/root"
    done
}

cpu=$(dpkg --print-architecture)
debian_index "$cpu"
version="$(debian_version bzflag-server) $(debian_version libcares2)"
if [ -x bzfs ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "BZFlag ${version%%-*} is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading BZFlag ${version%%-*} from Debian"
    debian_unpack bzflag-server libcares2
    r="$build/root"
    mkdir -p lib
    cp -a "$r"/usr/lib/*-linux-gnu/libcares.so.2* lib/
    rm -rf plugins && cp -a "$r/usr/lib/bzflag-server" plugins
    rm -rf examples && cp -a "$r/usr/share/doc/bzflag-server/examples" examples
    mv -f "$r/usr/games/bzfs" bzfs.new && mv -f bzfs.new bzfs
    echo "$version" > .raptor-version
fi

if [ ! -f bzfs.conf ]; then
    cat > bzfs.conf <<'CFG'
# bzfs settings, one option per line (see examples/bzfs.conf and
# https://wiki.bzflag.org/BZFS_Command_Line_Options). The port, players,
# game style, map, passwords and public listing are set from the server's
# variables at start.
# Jumping, the recommended acceleration limit, and up to 3 shots each.
-j
-a 50 38
-ms 3
# Kick players idle for 5 minutes, and those with very bad lag.
-maxidle 300
-lagwarn 600
-lagdrop 3
# Keep bans and player reports between restarts.
-banfile bans.txt
-reportfile reports.txt
CFG
fi
touch bans.txt
echo "Installed BZFlag ${version%%-*}."

variables.name: Game style
variables.description: ffa (teams, no flags to capture), offa (every tank for itself), ctf (capture the flag) or rabbit (everyone hunts the rabbit).

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can join at once.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: A map file in the server's folder, such as examples/hix.bzw. Empty, bzfs makes a random world.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password for /password in the game, which gives a player the admin commands. Empty, nobody can log in as admin.

variables.name: Public list key
variables.description: A server key from my.bzflag.org, which lists the server in the in-game server list. Empty, the server isn't listed.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The description players see in the public server list.

variables.name: Public address
variables.description: The address players reach the server at, such as bz.example.com, for the public list. Empty, the server's IP address.
